property_summary: For any admissible initialize call with _feeRate <= 5000 and _nft != _baseToken, the reference stores nft = _nft, so c.nft() == _nft always; the mutant stores _baseToken, breaking it for any input where the two differ.
change_summary: Assign _baseToken to nft instead of _nft, so the stored nft address is wrong.
